description: Use this when the user wants an existing video improved: burned-in captions, enhanced picture and sound, the background removed, or silences cut out (jump cut). Starts the edit and returns an id right away; video_status reports when the new video is ready. The original is kept; the result is saved to their Xenition library.

language.description: for captions: the spoken language code, e.g. 'en'

operation.description: captions (burn in subtitles), enhance (clean up picture and sound), matte (remove the background) or jumpcut (cut out silences)

video.description: https URL of the video to edit (e.g. from create_video or the user's library)

name: edit_video
title: Edit a video
